description: M2 benchmark (plan §8): timings, memory and sizes on the named hardware below

end_to_end_http.server_and_worker_peak_rss: not measured (ps reports the current RSS of the server only)

agreement.against: the frozen fixture from the independent reference implementation (tools/reference)
agreement.legacy: Legacy acceptance rate: NOT MEASURED. The 1998 grid search accepts a point when |Dobs - Dcalc| <= 10*|Dobs| for every coupling (bug report B08, default allowance); the rate this gives depends on the data and is not established. Measuring it needs the 1998 fit pipeline, which is not compiled: tools/legacy-harness compiles only the 1998 solver routines (eigenvalues, linear systems), which are wrong in 5 of their 7 frozen cases. The fit semantics differ (D3), so legacy numbers are not a target.

notes: single_core vs default_threads is a thread-limit experiment: the kernel run with the OMP, OpenBLAS, MKL and vecLib thread variables set to 1 vs the inherited environment. The effective thread counts of the BLAS backend are not recorded, and the HTTP timings ran in the inherited environment only.
Peak RSS is measured for the kernel process (ru_maxrss). The server's RSS is sampled once, after the runs; the peaks of the server and of its worker processes are not measured.
Attributions of time (worker spawn, HTTP/registry overhead) are hypotheses: the components are not timed separately.
perception_target: 04 §8.6: 'within 200 ms' on named hardware; the server half is highlight_then_describe_view
